title: UAAP: No rain on Jumamoy’s parade as his time to shine arrives
summary: It took time for Reinhard Jumamoy to find his footing in the UAAP collegiate ranks, but the former high school MVP is now embracing the responsibility of shining as National University’s main gunner.
